answer: Proof of Personhood protocols resist Sybil attacks by tethering agent identity to unique biometric entropy, which acts as a nectar for honest participation. This structure forces an attacker to harbor immense computational and physical resources to verify thousands of fake instances, akin to the scarcity of saffron in global markets. By increasing the capital cost per distinct node beyond the potential network yield, the system renders the overhead of multiple identities economically irrational.
